name: Minotaurasaurus
isnote: Suggested to be a synonym of Tarchia, but more recent publications treat it as distinct (cited revision); placed in Ankylosauridae.
sum: Minotaurasaurus is a medium-sized ankylosaurid known from a bull-like skull of unknown origin, thought to come from the Djadokhta Formation of Mongolia.
wsnote: Estimate for the immature type specimen (cited Wikipedia revision).
holotype: INBR21004, a skull with lower jaws and predentary, suspected to have been illegally exported from Mongolia.
material: Two skulls, a cervical vertebra and a cervical half ring.
biology: Known only from skulls; the sources used give no behavioural data.
author: Miles and Miles 2009

images.caption: Cast of the skull of Minotaurasaurus.
